**Dispatched** to an `os-dev` subagent (`mode:subagent`, `model: opus`) at 2026-09-20T11:24Z, batch slot 5/5. This comment is the order's record.

## The trap the order names explicitly

⛔ **No raw English literal swapped in for the raw Chinese one.** The card's own scope note says why, and the order repeats it as a refusal: the string is user-visible, so it wants the i18n treatment the surrounding surface already uses. A hard-coded English tooltip satisfies the letter of commandment #-1 and leaves the surface untranslatable — the worse of the two outcomes for an international project.

⚠️ And the stop condition beside it: if the surrounding surface turns out to have NO i18n mechanism reaching this component, the dev STOPS and reports. Wiring i18n into a component that has none is a larger change than this card describes and is ⛔ not the dev's to decide.

The order also says to translate the MEANING and not the characters, and to match how this console writes its other tooltips.

## The card's second half is declared unmeasured, so the order makes measuring it the deliverable

The Chinese source comments in `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` were reported by another dev and ⛔ NOT re-verified by the filing seat. The dev must measure them with a control in the same command — a probe shown finding non-ASCII somewhere, so a zero is a reading and ⛔ not a dark instrument — may repair comments ONLY in the same PR, and must report that half separately with its own before/after.

## Triage's extra question is answered, ⛔ not acted on

> ⚠️ **The fix is one attribute; the question worth one extra minute is whether a gate exists** — a commandment this absolute with no mechanical reader will be violated again.

The dev reports whether any gate mechanically enforces #-1 over user-facing strings, with evidence. ⛔ It does NOT build one, widen one, or add a check: a new required gate is a maintainer-floor decision this card did not ask for. The answer is what lets this seat file it properly if none exists.

## Landing is this seat's

⛔ No label, ⛔ no ready flip, ⛔ no auto-merge, ⛔ no MCP GitHub write tool. The PR stays DRAFT.

## The trap the order named was avoided, and the alternative was rejected on a measurement

⛔ No raw English literal. The tooltip resolves through `useObjectTranslation` and a new `console.studio.backToHome` key added to **all ten** locale packs — the mechanism the surrounding console surface already uses, and the one objectui#4024 ruled for `console.settingsView` in the same situation.

⭐ The sibling screen's mechanism (`app-shell`'s `engine.studio.home`) was **evaluated and rejected with a reason**, not overlooked: `@object-ui/app-shell` publishes only its dot entry and that barrel exports neither the metadata-admin `t` nor `useMetadataLocale`, so reaching for it would have meant **widening a package's public surface** to fix a tooltip. ⛔ Correctly refused.

⚠️ One consequence is named openly rather than buried: the ten values are this repo's **own existing wording** for 「Back to home」 (each pack's `empty.appAccessDeniedHome`), so the zh value is now the pack's established synonym (`返回首页`) rather than the exact characters removed (`返回主页`). ⭐ That is the right trade — one wording per concept per pack beats a second spelling — and saying so is what makes it a decision instead of a drift.

## ⭐ The dark instrument, caught by its own control

This is the part worth keeping. The dev's FIRST probe for the card's unmeasured second half was `grep -P` with the Han property class — and it returned **0 on the subject AND 0 on a file provably full of Han**. ⛔ The container's `grep` does not honour that class. Reporting 「absent」 from it would have been exactly the error the order warned about, and the control is the only reason it did not happen.

Re-measured with a working probe, subject and control in the SAME command: `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` reads **30** Han-lines before and **0** after, while the control file `metadata-admin/i18n.ts` reads **2009** in the same run. ⇒ the zero is a reading. ⚠️ Recorded as an agent-environment hazard for whoever measures a script class next.

**COMMENTS-ONLY was proved mechanically, ⛔ not by eye**: both revisions emitted with `removeComments: true` and hashed — byte-identical, 125,428 bytes, same sha256 — and the same instrument on a copy with one identifier renamed reports DIFFERENT, so the equality is ⛔ not vacuous. The control mutation was made on a COPY, so the tree was never mutated and needed no restore leg.

The i18n gate's own ablation is real too: the call site was repointed at a non-existent key, the mutation proved on disk (blob `49449c46` → `51017219`), and `check:i18n-keys` went RED naming the exact site — then restored by CONTENT and HASH with `git diff HEAD` empty, ⛔ never by an exit code.

## Triage's extra question is ANSWERED, and the answer is a card

> ⚠️ The fix is one attribute; the question worth one extra minute is whether a gate exists.

⭐ **No gate mechanically enforces commandment #-1** — established by elimination against a probe shown to work: no ESLint rule (the repo's 11 custom rules are about other things); no workflow scans for non-English text; `check:control-bytes` is scoped by its own header to control characters, ⛔ not to letters outside ASCII, and was green on this defect **by design**; `check:i18n-keys` reports a `t()` key no pack defines, so a hardcoded literal that calls no `t()` is invisible to it and it too was green on this exact line. What exists is narrow and per-component and generalises past nothing.

⛔ And no gate was built, widened or added — a new required gate is a maintainer-floor decision this card did not ask for. ⭐ Exactly right.

A card follows for the scale input the dev measured (Han outside locale catalogues across the tracked tree), re-measured first-hand by this seat before filing, per 说明 GG.
